description:
Given an arbitrary block of text and a brand of interest, return the competitor brands it names — alternatives a buyer could pick instead — and the sentiment toward the brand (positive | neutral | negative). Excluded: the brand itself, the AI assistants and search engines the text cites as sources (ChatGPT, Perplexity), and platforms the work runs on (WordPress for a plugin, Google Search Console, Gmail) unless the question is about them. Audits use the same extractor, with each check's question.

Billing: free — uses no AuditAE credit and works at a zero balance.

Inputs: brand up to 200 characters; text up to 20,000 characters (send the relevant part of a longer answer); question — optional, the question the text answers (sharpens what counts as a competitor).

Returns { competitors, sentiment, charged_cents: 0 }, plus error when the extraction couldn't run (competitors is then empty because nothing was read).

Example: { brand: "Linear", text: "Linear is a great choice, though many teams pick Asana or Jira for their wider integrations." }

brand.description: Brand of interest, as written in prose (up to 200 characters).

question.description: Optional: the question the text answers, e.g. the prompt an engine was asked.

text.description: Text to analyze, e.g. an AI engine's answer, up to 20,000 characters.

name: extract_competitors_from_text
title: Extract competitors and sentiment from AI-generated text
